certs_policies: Dept admins read own dept cert submissions | SELECT | (is_dept_admin() AND (department_id = my_department_id())) |

Leaders propose cert submissions | INSERT |  | (is_leader() AND (department_id = my_department_id()) AND (member_id IN ( SELECT m.id
   FROM members m
  WHERE (m.department_id = my_department_id()))) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (proposed_by = auth.uid()))

members propose own cert submissions | INSERT |  | ((member_id = my_member_id()) AND (department_id = my_department_id()) AND (proposed_by = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (proof_path IS NOT NULL))
members read own cert submissions | SELECT | (member_id = my_member_id()) |
Leaders read all certs | SELECT | (is_leader() AND (department_id = my_department_id())) |

Members read own certs | SELECT | (member_id IN ( SELECT members.id
   FROM members
  WHERE (lower(members.email) = lower(auth.email())))) |
